# Suyash Dubey — Applied / Forward-Deployed AI Engineer

> Independent AI engineer and consultant. Builds agentic systems, RAG pipelines
> and production LLM products. Three years shipping in healthcare and public
> digital infrastructure. Remote from India (IST), working with clients in the
> US, UK, Europe and Australia.

Contact: dsuyash57@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/suyash-kumar-dubey-410533211
GitHub: https://github.com/suyashdube

## Services
- AI MVP development — 4–6 weeks, zero to one, ends in a deployed system.
- Agentic systems and RAG engineering — LangGraph state machines, tool use,
  human-in-the-loop review, grounded retrieval.
- AI strategy and forward-deployed consulting — 1–2 week discovery sprint ending
  in an architecture and a costed roadmap.
- LLM evaluation, observability and governance — eval harnesses, Langfuse
  tracing, prompt versioning, PII/PHI redaction, governance mapped to controls.

## Core stack
LangGraph, LangChain, FastAPI, AWS Bedrock, Langfuse, FAISS/Chroma, Kubernetes,
Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL, Terraform, PyTorch.
